newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Composite insurers cut at Laing.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Composite insurers cut at Laing.

text.p: The UK composite insurance sector was cut to "underweight" from "neutral" at Credit Lyonnais Laing, market sources said on Friday.

Analysts at the brokerage said they expected a series of downgradings in profit expectations in coming weeks due to a combination of negative factors including the strength of sterling, recent bad weather and bond market wobbles.
"You are going to get analysts downgrading their forecasts for 1996 and 1997 and against that backdrop it will be difficult for the sector to make any progress," said one.
In the sector, General Accident Plc was down 1/2p at 740 by 0959 GMT but Commercial Union Plc was up 7-1/2p at 675 and Guardian Royal Exchange Plc was up 6p at 279-1/2.
